messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — opened PR #4821 for the function-calling docs. Realized our JS SDK snippet doesn't match the schema example for the `metadata` envelope. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821

oliver: Thanks! Can you paste the snippet that currently fails? I tried the examples locally and got parse errors.

maria: Sure — here's the offending example:
```
{
  "tool": "user_lookup",
  "input": {
    "user_id": 12345
  },
  "metadata": {
    "created_at": "2024-01-02T12:00:00Z",
    "attempts": 1
  }
}
```

oliver: Ah — schema expects `user_id` as a string and `metadata.attempts` optional. Also we prefer `ts` instead of `created_at` to be consistent with other examples.

sanjay: I'll update the SDK snippet to coerce numeric ids to strings and add a short note about the envelope shape. Assigning to me.

eva: FYI the anchor link in the migration guide to `#function-caller-envelopes` 404s — probably renamed in previous PR.

maria: Good catch, eva. I'll fix links in the PR.

docs-bot: linked PR 4821 -> added "needs-sdk" label :robot_face:

oliver: For the JS SDK example, can we add a minimal wrapper showing `response.parse()` output? devs keep asking how to unwrap the `result` field.

sanjay: plan: add `parse()` snippet + test in examples folder. Will send follow-up commit today.

maria: If anyone can quick-review the link fix and schema change after sanjay's commit, that'd speed merge. I'm short on time today.

eva: I'll review link and do a quick smoke of examples after sanjay's push. :thumbsup:

maria: Thanks! I'll update PR description to call out backwards-incompatible detail (id coercion) and add migration note.

oliver: Optional: add a short section in the migration guide with `sed` command to replace numeric ids in bulk.

maria: Good idea, adding.

docs-bot: PR 4821 updated with label "docs:needs-review" (timestamp 4732106789)

maria: closing loop — created follow-up issue for lingering examples (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/690). Let's fold into next docs sprint.
